% A document that changed from biblatex to bibtex: the .aux and the .bbl
% of its earlier biblatex build are beside it. The PDF build reads the
% stale .bbl in its first run, then bibtex writes a new one; the page's
% build has its own folder and must not read the stale one. The
% citation and the entry are bibtex's, from the .bib.
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
Cited~\cite{fresh}.
\bibliographystyle{plain}
\bibliography{test-staleaux-bbl}
\end{document}
